card.name: Word 'including' in volume-depleted patients warning
card.fires_on: The word "including" inside the parenthetical "volume-depleted (including those on diuretic therapy)" in kidney-risk warnings about COX-2 inhibitors. Also a comma after "acute myocardial infarction" in a list of shock-like conditions.

modes.label: Including before diuretics
modes.description: The word "including" opens a parenthetical after "volume-depleted" in a warning about elderly patients.
modes.example: In patients who are elderly, volume-depleted (<<including>> those on diuretic therapy), or

modes.label: Comma in condition list
modes.description: A comma after "acute myocardial infarction" in a list of conditions such as shock and sepsis.
modes.example: CV collapse (shock), acute myocardial infarction<<,>> sepsis, and other conditions associated

card.plain: It marks a fixed phrase in kidney warnings, where the text lists groups of patients or conditions at risk.
